messages:
maria: Hey team — Acme asked to expand the POC: add embeddings + rerank, push BYO-KMS, and wants timeline shortened to ~3 weeks. They quoted ~200 qps target and asked for p95 < 200ms. Need: updated success criteria, rough pricing delta, and a short checklist to present to the customer by EOD. cc @derek @ananya

derek: Quick take: embeddings + rerank = additional embedding model + vector DB. We can integrate an external vectordb from hosted, but BYO-KMS changes everything (Private or Dedicated). Rerank at 200 qps with p95 <200ms is ambitious — we need candidate pruning and a fast rerank model.

ananya: Draft success criteria (minimal):
- recall@10 >= 0.85 on their eval set (we'll request their labeled prompts)
- end-to-end p95 latency <= 250ms for chat+rerank (if they insist on 200ms we should require Dedicated)
- throughput: sustain 200 qps for 30m window without >5% error rate
- security: BYO-KMS approval + network ACLs in place
- run a 3-day canary with their eval prompts and metrics dashboard

ethan: Engineering notes:
- embeddings: use int8 quantized model + async batching to reduce cost/latency
- rerank: do a cheap lexical prefilter (top 100) then neural rerank (top 10)
- for steady p95 <250ms at 200 qps recommend Dedicated (2x A100 equiv) or an autoscale policy with reserved capacity
- Hosted can work for functional validation only, not the latency SLA

sam: BYO-KMS constraints:
- BYO keys require either Private deployment or Dedicated in a customer VPC setup; hosted cannot support customer-managed keys with egress restrictions
- we need their key policy, KMS endpoint, and IP allowlist; timeline: expect 10 business days for security review + legal addendum
- additional audit logs and KMIP/HSM requirements may increase integration time

maria: Can someone give a short cost-delta estimate (hosted vs dedicated) and a one-page checklist I can use in the call?

derek: Ballpark numbers (very rough):
- Hosted (with external vectordb): +$0.05/embedding + standard generation token costs; no infra commit, but latency not guaranteed
- Dedicated (reserved): ~ $18k-$35k/month depending on GPU type and redundancy (includes lower per-token cost and predictable p95)
- BYO-KMS + Private adds professional services 2-4w and ~$5k onboarding fee

```yaml
eval_spec:
  prompt_set: "acme-kb-1000"
  metrics: [recall@10, p95_latency, error_rate]
  acceptance: {recall@10: 0.85, p95_latency: 250}
```

ethan: I'll ping finance for a clean quote tomorrow; those numbers are engineering-level estimates.

ananya: Proposed customer-facing options to present:
Option A: Hosted + external vectordb, no BYO-KMS, target p95 300-350ms, 2-week trial, lower cost.
Option B: Dedicated + BYO-KMS, target p95 <=250ms, 3-week delivery for infra + 3-day canary, higher monthly commit.

maria: Perfect. I also need a short SE checklist to run the call and capture approvals.

derek: SE checklist (short):
- Confirm eval prompt set and labeled positives/negatives
- Confirm target throughput and p95 SLA (explicit numbers)
- Confirm BYO-KMS decision + provide KMS endpoint and policies
- Agree on vectordb approach (external vs provided integration)
- Approve canary window + acceptance metrics
- Get PO or trial commitment (if Dedicated)

ops-bot: scheduled internal pre-sales sync: Thu 10:00am PT — invite sent to maria, derek, ananya, ethan, sam.

maria: Thanks all — I'll present Option A/B on the 2pm call with Acme and reconvene here after. If they push hard on p95=200ms we'll escalate to Dedicated.

derek: 👍 will prepare the short demo config and eval harness tonight.

ananya: I'll draft the customer email with acceptance criteria and the two options.

maria: End state: collect their eval set + KMS decision. Back here after call. Thanks!"
